name: Edit

file_path.description: Absolute path to the existing file.

old_string.description: Nonempty text to match exactly, including whitespace.

new_string.description: Replacement text; must differ from old_string.

replace_all.description: Replace every match if true; otherwise require exactly one match (default).

description:
[MCP:peri] Replace exact text in an existing file at an absolute path.
Usage: Use a nonempty `old_string` and a different replacement. Preserve source whitespace and omit Read line-number prefixes. By default exactly one match is required; add surrounding context or use `replace_all=true` for every match. A missing file or match is an error.
